title: Robot vacuum with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow under vacuum -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="34" ry="6" fill="#1a1a3a" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- main body - rounded disc shape -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="36" ry="22" fill="#4a90d9"/>
  
  <!-- top surface slightly lighter -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="34" ry="19" fill="#5da8f0"/>
  
  <!-- rim edge highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="36" ry="22" fill="none" stroke="#7ec0ff" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- bumper ring - front darker blue -->
  <path d="M 14 62 Q 50 88 86 62" fill="none" stroke="#2d6bb5" stroke-width="4"/>
  
  <!-- face screen area -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="56" rx="20" ry="12" fill="#1a1a3a"/>
  
  <!-- glowing eyes - happy curved -->
  <path d="M 38 54 Q 41 49 44 54" fill="none" stroke="#5df3a0" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 56 54 Q 59 49 62 54" fill="none" stroke="#5df3a0" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M 40 59 Q 50 66 60 59" fill="none" stroke="#5df3a0" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- little cheek blushes -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="58" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#ff6b9d" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="58" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#ff6b9d" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- top sensor bump -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#3a7cc4"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="41" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#6db8ff"/>
  
  <!-- little light on sensor -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="1.5" fill="#5df3a0"/>
  
  <!-- side wheels visible -->
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="70" rx="6" ry="10" fill="#2d2d5a"/>
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="70" rx="4" ry="7" fill="#3d3d7a"/>
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="70" rx="6" ry="10" fill="#2d2d5a"/>
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="70" rx="4" ry="7" fill="#3d3d7a"/>
  
  <!-- front bumper strip -->
  <path d="M 20 68 Q 50 84 80 68" fill="none" stroke="#3d8ee0" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- tiny sparkle accents -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="48" r="1" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="48" r="1" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
